```{r cars}

#correlation analysis 

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

# Read CSV file
df <- read_csv("/Users/chhugani/Downloads/SAB_Serum_WBC_Dogra.csv")

# Keep Day 1 samples only
day1_df <- df %>%
  filter(Day == 1) %>%
  select(
    `Study ID`,
    Age,
    TTP,
    `Platelet...16`,
    `cDC (from raw xCell)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(Age, TTP, `Platelet...16`, `cDC (from raw xCell)`),
      as.numeric
    )
  )

# Variables to correlate with Day 1 cDC
clinical_vars <- c("Age", "TTP", "Platelet...16")

# Function to run Spearman correlations
run_spearman <- function(var_name) {

  temp_df <- day1_df %>%
    select(`cDC (from raw xCell)`, all_of(var_name)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))

  test <- cor.test(
    temp_df$`cDC (from raw xCell)`,
    temp_df[[var_name]],
    method = "spearman",
    exact = FALSE
  )

  tibble(
    variable = var_name,
    n = nrow(temp_df),
    spearman_rho = unname(test$estimate),
    p_value = test$p.value
  )
}

# Run correlations
correlation_results <- map_dfr(clinical_vars, run_spearman) %>%
  mutate(
    fdr_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

# View results
print(correlation_results)

# Save results
write_csv(
  correlation_results,
  "/Users/chhugani/Downloads/day1_cdc_clinical_correlations.csv"
)
```

```{r}
#comparison of categorical variables 

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

# Read data
df <- read_csv("/Users/chhugani/Downloads/SAB_Serum_WBC_Dogra.csv")

# Keep Day 1 samples only
day1_df <- df %>%
  filter(Day == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    `cDC (from raw xCell)` = as.numeric(`cDC (from raw xCell)`)
  )

# Categorical variables to test
categorical_vars <- c(
  "initial_abx_group",
  "source_risk_group",
  "admitting_dx_group",
  "diabetes",
  "renal_disease",
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "heme_onc",
  "obesity",
  "pulmonary_disease"
)

# Function for categorical comparisons
run_categorical_test <- function(var_name) {
  
  temp_df <- day1_df %>%
    select(`cDC (from raw xCell)`, all_of(var_name)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
    filter(.data[[var_name]] != "")
  
  n_groups <- length(unique(temp_df[[var_name]]))
  
  if (n_groups < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      variable = var_name,
      n = nrow(temp_df),
      groups = n_groups,
      test = NA_character_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  if (n_groups == 2) {
    test_result <- wilcox.test(
      temp_df$`cDC (from raw xCell)` ~ temp_df[[var_name]],
      exact = FALSE
    )
    test_name <- "Wilcoxon rank-sum"
  } else {
    test_result <- kruskal.test(
      temp_df$`cDC (from raw xCell)` ~ temp_df[[var_name]]
    )
    test_name <- "Kruskal-Wallis"
  }
  
  tibble(
    variable = var_name,
    n = nrow(temp_df),
    groups = n_groups,
    test = test_name,
    p_value = test_result$p.value
  )
}

# Run tests
categorical_results <- map_dfr(categorical_vars, run_categorical_test) %>%
  mutate(
    fdr_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

# View results
print(categorical_results)

# Save results
write_csv(
  categorical_results,
  "/Users/chhugani/Downloads/day1_cdc_categorical_comparisons.csv"
)








```
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(patchwork)

# Variables to plot
categorical_vars <- c(
  "initial_abx_group",
  "source_risk_group",
  "admitting_dx_group",
  "diabetes",
  "renal_disease",
  "cardiovascular_disease",
  "heme_onc",
  "obesity",
  "pulmonary_disease"
)

# Function to make one plot per categorical variable
make_categorical_plot <- function(var_name) {
  
  temp_df <- day1_df %>%
    select(`cDC (from raw xCell)`, all_of(var_name)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
    filter(.data[[var_name]] != "")
  
  result_row <- categorical_results %>%
    filter(variable == var_name)
  
  test_label <- ifelse(
    is.na(result_row$test),
    "Not tested",
    paste0(result_row$test, "\np = ", signif(result_row$p_value, 3))
  )
  
  ggplot(
    temp_df,
    aes(
      x = .data[[var_name]],
      y = `cDC (from raw xCell)`
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 3, alpha = 0.85) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = test_label,
      hjust = 1.05,
      vjust = 1.3,
      size = 4.5
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(500, 1500), clip = "off") +
    labs(
      title = var_name,
      x = "",
      y = "Day 1 cDC score"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    )
}

# Generate plots
categorical_plots <- map(categorical_vars, make_categorical_plot)

# Combine plots into panel
combined_categorical_plot <- wrap_plots(categorical_plots, ncol = 3)

combined_categorical_plot

combined_categorical_plot <- wrap_plots(categorical_plots, ncol = 3)

ggsave(
  "/Users/chhugani/Downloads/Day1_cDC_categorical_comparisons_updated_9.png",
  combined_categorical_plot,
  width = 24,
  height = 20,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
#extended analysis -Day 1 cDC categorical clinical comparisons

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Read CSV
df <- read_csv("/Users/chhugani/Downloads/SAB_Serum_WBC_Dogra.csv")

# Keep Day 1 samples only
day1_df <- df %>%
  filter(Day == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    `cDC (from raw xCell)` = as.numeric(`cDC (from raw xCell)`),
    Glucose = as.numeric(Glucose)
  )

# Create glucose categorical variable
day1_df <- day1_df %>%
  mutate(
    glucose_group = ifelse(
      Glucose > 150,
      ">150",
      "<=150"
    )
  )

# Categorical variables to test
categorical_vars <- c(
  "Platelet_onset",
  "Severity of Sepsis",
  "ICU adm within 48h diagnosis",
  "glucose_group"
)

# Function for categorical comparisons
run_categorical_test <- function(var_name) {
  
  temp_df <- day1_df %>%
    select(`cDC (from raw xCell)`, all_of(var_name)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
    filter(.data[[var_name]] != "") %>%
    filter(.data[[var_name]] != "N/A")
  
  n_groups <- length(unique(temp_df[[var_name]]))
  
  if (n_groups < 2) {
    return(tibble(
      variable = var_name,
      n = nrow(temp_df),
      groups = n_groups,
      test = NA_character_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  if (n_groups == 2) {
    
    test_result <- wilcox.test(
      temp_df$`cDC (from raw xCell)` ~ temp_df[[var_name]],
      exact = FALSE
    )
    
    test_name <- "Wilcoxon rank-sum"
    
  } else {
    
    test_result <- kruskal.test(
      temp_df$`cDC (from raw xCell)` ~ temp_df[[var_name]]
    )
    
    test_name <- "Kruskal-Wallis"
  }
  
  tibble(
    variable = var_name,
    n = nrow(temp_df),
    groups = n_groups,
    test = test_name,
    p_value = test_result$p.value
  )
}

# Run tests
categorical_results <- map_dfr(categorical_vars, run_categorical_test) %>%
  mutate(
    fdr_bh = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")
  )

# View results
print(categorical_results)

# Save results
write_csv(
  categorical_results,
  "/Users/chhugani/Downloads/day1_cdc_updated_categorical_comparisons.csv"
)

# -----------------------------
# Create plots
# -----------------------------

make_categorical_plot <- function(var_name) {
  
  temp_df <- day1_df %>%
    select(`cDC (from raw xCell)`, all_of(var_name)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
    filter(.data[[var_name]] != "") %>%
    filter(.data[[var_name]] != "N/A")
  
  result_row <- categorical_results %>%
    filter(variable == var_name)
  
  test_label <- ifelse(
    is.na(result_row$test),
    "Not tested",
    paste0(
      result_row$test,
      "\np = ",
      signif(result_row$p_value, 3)
    )
  )
  
  ggplot(
    temp_df,
    aes(
      x = .data[[var_name]],
      y = `cDC (from raw xCell)`
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      outlier.shape = NA,
      width = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.12,
      size = 3,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = test_label,
      hjust = 1.05,
      vjust = 1.3,
      size = 4.5
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(500, 1500),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = var_name,
      x = "",
      y = "Day 1 cDC score"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    )
}

# Generate plots
categorical_plots <- map(categorical_vars, make_categorical_plot)

# Combine plots
combined_categorical_plot <- wrap_plots(
  categorical_plots,
  ncol = 2
)

# Display figure
combined_categorical_plot

# Save figure
ggsave(
  "/Users/chhugani/Downloads/Day1_cDC_updated_categorical_comparisons.png",

  height = 14,

)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

#continuous

# Only include immune cell variables + WBC
panel_vars <- c(
  "WBC",
  "Neutrophil %",
  "lymphocyte %...14",
  "monocyte %...15"
)

# Clean labels
plot_labels <- c(
  "WBC" = "WBC",
  "Neutrophil %" = "Neutrophil %",
  "lymphocyte %...14" = "Lymphocyte %",
  "monocyte %...15" = "Monocyte %"
)

# Function to generate plots
make_correlation_plot <- function(var_name) {
  
  temp_df <- day1_df %>%
    select(`cDC (from raw xCell)`, all_of(var_name)) %>%
    filter(complete.cases(.))
  
  stats_row <- correlation_results %>%
    filter(variable == var_name)
  
  label_text <- paste0(
    "rho = ", round(stats_row$spearman_rho, 2),
    "\nP = ", signif(stats_row$p_value, 2)
  )
  
  ggplot(
    temp_df,
    aes(x = .data[[var_name]], y = `cDC (from raw xCell)`)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = Inf,
      y = Inf,
      label = label_text,
      hjust = 1.1,
      vjust = 1.2,
      size = 4
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_labels[[var_name]],
      x = plot_labels[[var_name]],
      y = "cDC (raw xCell)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13)
}

# Generate plots
plot_list <- map(panel_vars, make_correlation_plot)

# Combine into one panel
combined_plot <- wrap_plots(plot_list, ncol = 2)

# View plot
combined_plot

# Save figure

  "/Users/chhugani/Downloads/day1_cdc_immune_correlations_panel.png",
```

```{r}
#converting immune cells into categorical 


# Create clinically based categorical variables

day1_df <- day1_df %>%
  mutate(
    
    # WBC categories
    wbc_group = case_when(
      WBC < 4.5 ~ "Low",
      WBC >= 4.5 & WBC <= 11 ~ "Normal",
      WBC > 11 ~ "High"
    ),
    
    # Neutrophil %
    neutrophil_group = case_when(
      `Neutrophil %` < 55 ~ "Low",
      `Neutrophil %` >= 55 & `Neutrophil %` <= 70 ~ "Normal",
      `Neutrophil %` > 70 ~ "High"
    ),
    
    # Lymphocyte %
    lymphocyte_group = case_when(
      `lymphocyte %...14` < 20 ~ "Low",
      `lymphocyte %...14` >= 20 & `lymphocyte %...14` <= 40 ~ "Normal",
      `lymphocyte %...14` > 40 ~ "High"
    ),
    
    # Monocyte %
    monocyte_group = case_when(
      `monocyte %...15` < 2 ~ "Low",
      `monocyte %...15` >= 2 & `monocyte %...15` <= 8 ~ "Normal",
      `monocyte %...15` > 8 ~ "High"
    )
    
  )
```

```{r}
# Keep only Day 1 samples with age + outcome group
age_df <- df %>%
  filter(Day == 1) %>%
  select(`Study ID`, `Persistent or Resolving`, Age) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Persistent or Resolving`), !is.na(Age))

# View sample sizes
table(age_df$`Persistent or Resolving`)

# Summary statistics
age_df %>%
  group_by(`Persistent or Resolving`) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    median_age = median(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_age = mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(Age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Wilcoxon rank-sum test
wilcox.test(
  Age ~ `Persistent or Resolving`,
  data = age_df
)
```
